players.product: Optical thin-film deposition equipment for data-center optical transceivers: vapor deposition (OTFC-1300 / SPOC-1300) for AR/HR and WDM/TFF filter films on lasers, optical filters and modules; sputtering (OWLS-1800 / SPOC-S-1200) for SiPh PIC, TFLN and optical-engine films; ALD and etching systems

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January - June 2026): net sales JPY 15,853 million (up 14.5%), operating income JPY 1,087 million (down 1.9%), ordinary income JPY 717 million (down 35.5%), and a net loss attributable to owners of the parent of JPY 17 million (net income of JPY 1,105 million a year earlier). Management states sales rose on strong sales of equipment for smartphone camera modules in the optics domain and for AI-data-center optical communications; operating income fell despite a better cost ratio from the equipment sales mix and lower SG&A, because of inventory valuation losses and a provision for doubtful accounts; ordinary income fell on foreign-exchange losses and equity-method investment losses.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 15,853 million (+14.5%); operating income JPY 1,087 million (-1.9%); net loss JPY 17 million

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 film-deposition equipment business: orders received JPY 32,584,763 thousand, production JPY 14,166,104 thousand at manufacturing cost. Revenue by field: optics JPY 13,991,745 thousand (H1 FY2025 JPY 10,196,009 thousand), semiconductor-optics convergence JPY 798,555 thousand (JPY 1,449,387 thousand), other JPY 1,063,610 thousand (JPY 2,205,082 thousand). Contract liabilities rose by JPY 12,499 million in the half; H1 R&D expenses JPY 1,445 million.
